SECTION_1_MCP_UNREAL_ENGINE_SETUP.label: 7-Gate MCP Setup for Unreal Engine 5
gates: 1. Install Claude Code CLI and confirm version
2. Install UE5 MCP plugin from Marketplace or source
3. Enable plugin in Editor > Plugins; restart editor
4. Set MCP server host/port in plugin settings (default 3000)
5. Launch MCP server from terminal before opening Claude Code
6. Confirm handshake: Claude Code lists UE tools in /tools
7. Run a smoke test (e.g., list_actors) before any generation task
failure_modes: Port conflict: change MCP port, restart both editor and server
Plugin not found: verify UE version match before install
Tool list empty: server must be running BEFORE Claude Code session starts

SECTION_2_BLENDER_CLAUDE_MCP_WORKFLOW.label: Blender + Claude MCP Automation Patterns
rules: Use Claude MCP to script object creation, material assignment, and render triggers via Blender Python API
Segment large scene tasks: one MCP call per logical unit (mesh, rig, material) to avoid token overflow and partial failures
Animation retargeting: use IK Retargeter in UE5 to map source skeleton to target; always bind root bone first
Terrain layering: paint weight maps per material layer; use Landscape Layer Blend node for multi-material surfaces
Post-process volume: tune Bloom, Chromatic Aberration, and Vignette last after lighting is locked

SECTION_3_UNREAL_ENGINE_5_WORLD_BUILDING.label: UE5 World-Building Technical Doctrine
nanite_lod: Enable Nanite on static meshes that exceed 50k triangles; skip on foliage billboards
Nanite does NOT replace LOD for foliage: use dual-material system (main mesh + billboard) for distant foliage
Megascan assets: import via Bridge; confirm Nanite toggle per asset at import time, not globally
materials: Material parameter names must be consistent across instances for dynamic override to work
Multi-layer materials: use Material Attribute Layers node; avoid stacking separate materials on one mesh
Foliage main material: includes subsurface scattering + two-sided; billboard material: unlit + masked
blueprints: Ragdoll: bind 'Simulate Physics' to collision event on Actor; cast to Character BP, call SetSimulatePhysics(true)
Obstacle collision: use Box Collision, bind OnComponentHit, cast to Player BP, apply impulse
Frame-independence: always multiply movement/force values by Delta Seconds from Event Tick
Custom events: define on the owning Actor; call via 'Get Actor of Class' + Cast to fire cross-BP events
UI widgets: create in UMG, add to viewport in BeginPlay via Player Controller reference

SECTION_4_MULTIPLAYER_ARCHITECTURE.label: Multiplayer Game Architecture (InstantDB pattern)
rules: Use InstantDB (or equivalent real-time DB) for low-latency shared state; avoid polling, use subscriptions
Client-authoritative movement is acceptable for solo/indie scope; server-authoritative required for competitive
Sync only delta state per tick, not full world state
Session management: assign session ID at connect; invalidate on disconnect + timeout

SECTION_5_CLAUDE_CODE_INTEGRATION.label: Claude Code / Vibe Coding Operating Rules
mindset: Mindset shift: you work FOR Claude Code (supply direction + execution discipline), not vice versa. Claude handles code; human holds vision, taste, and judgment
Front-end design skill is the differentiator: AI generates structure; human refines to quality
Terminal-first workflow (e.g., Ghosty) reduces IDE friction and keeps context in one surface
context_management: Use markdown files as project context layers for AI handoffs: one file per domain (architecture, API contracts, open tasks)
Keep context files short and opinionated; verbose context degrades AI output quality
System-based operations: define specs in markdown first, then invoke AI against the spec
prompting: Eighth-grader clarity rule: if a non-technical person cannot understand the prompt, rewrite before sending
Provide examples of desired output shape in the prompt when format matters
Break compound tasks into single-responsibility prompts; chain results explicitly

SECTION_6_CONTENT_AND_LEAD_GEN.label: Content + LinkedIn Lead Generation Doctrines

inbound_outbound_method.inbound: Publish content, wait for signal (comments, profile views, connection requests), then DM warm leads
inbound_outbound_method.outbound: Proactive DM to cold targets immediately after publishing or after engaging their content
inbound_outbound_method.rule: Run both in parallel; inbound builds pipeline, outbound converts faster

qualified_view_strategy: 200 niche-relevant views outperform 10M general views for B2B conversion
Optimize for audience specificity, not raw reach
Use niche hashtags + direct tags to ICP accounts to force qualified distribution

tiers: Bundled service (build + support + iteration): highest LTV tier
mini_app_monetization.rule: Lead with done-for-you to prove value; pitch retainer at delivery
